description: This source file defines AliasMainActivity, a launcher activity that forwards to IndiceActivity. It is designed as the main entry point for certain scanners requiring a single explicit launcher activity.

classes.name: AliasMainActivity
classes.description: A simple Activity that on creation immediately launches IndiceActivity and finishes itself.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the Activity's onCreate to start IndiceActivity and then finish itself.
